claims.text: Most common hyperthyroidism tx in the US;
claims.quote: In the United States, iodine-131 is the most common treatment for hyperthyroidism.

claims.text: often recommended as the tx of choice for Graves and toxic nodular goiter, including in children.
claims.quote: Radioiodine is often recommended as the treatment of choice for Graves disease and toxic nodular goiter in all patients, including children.

claims.text: About 25–50% are hypothyroid 1 yr after a euthyroid dose, rising yearly;
claims.quote: When sufficient iodine-131 is given to cause euthyroidism, approximately 25 to 50% of patients become hypothyroid 1 year later, and the incidence continues to increase yearly.

claims.text: most eventually need thyroid hormone replacement.
claims.quote: Thus, most patients eventually become hypothyroid and require thyroid hormone replacement.

claims.text: Very small increased risk of secondary cancers reported, so some clinicians use antithyroid drugs instead.
claims.quote: Epidemiologic studies report a very small increased risk of secondary malignancies with I-131 treatment, depending on the type of cancer and length of follow-up (2), so some clinicians use antithyroid medications instead.
